members.name: EntityGolem
members.note: the subclass construct covers the base's work (super EntityCreature); EntityGolem adds no field or draw

members.name: fall
members.note: living_fall returns at once for VK_IRON_GOLEM (no damage, no rider fall); golem-fight-s42 drops a golem from y 95

members.name: canDespawn
members.note: living_can_despawn falls through to return 0 for VK_IRON_GOLEM, matching the base's false

notes: Snowman (the other subclass) is out of scope: world.conf built_golems = off, and snow golems never spawn naturally.
